mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 5.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 310 signals elevated inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 310 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) generates wage pressures that fuel inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising (month-over-month) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1300 thousand units signals a weakening housing market that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1300 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) indicates active monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 310 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 22700 billion dollars) indicates economic overheating that increases inflation risk and triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 22700 over a 3-year rolling window.
